purpose: Define an Expose view/editor boundary for accepted configuration, candidate edits, validation/diff, apply/reload status and rollback history.

owns: Configuration Monitor and Editor Boundary semantics

topics.name: Configuration Monitor and Editor Boundary
topics.purpose: Define an Expose view/editor boundary for accepted configuration, candidate edits, validation/diff, apply/reload status and rollback history.

semantics.candidate_rule: Editing remains candidate-only until explicit authorized apply.
semantics.identity_rule: Config schema/field, candidate, accepted revision, runtime instance and secret identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: validate/apply/reload/rollback operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/editing candidate does not grant apply/reload authority.
semantics.secret_rule: Secret values are never rendered; only safe secret refs/metadata.
semantics.failure_rule: Accepted-but-not-live, partial-reload and rollback-failed states are explicit.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: editor mutates live config while typing

prose.summary: Define an Expose view/editor boundary for accepted configuration, candidate edits, validation/diff, apply/reload status and rollback history.
